summary: There's a part of you that knows you swing between a need to be seen and to matter and a strong will and deep reserves of energy, and it often shows up through other people before you own both sides. Some days you shine and lead without trying; other days your temper gets ahead of you, or you sit on it until it leaks out sideways. The work is holding both without picking a side.
body: There's a part of you that knows you swing between a need to be seen and to matter and a strong will and deep reserves of energy, and it often shows up through other people before you own both sides. Some days you shine and lead without trying; other days your temper gets ahead of you, or you sit on it until it leaks out sideways. The work is holding both without picking a side. Initiative and drive; the cost is friction with authority and a tendency to force things.
gift: At your best: you shine and lead without trying, and you go after what you want and don't back down.
shadow: The trap: you make it all about you, or you shrink when no one's looking — or your temper gets ahead of you, or you sit on it until it leaks out sideways.
integration: Let identity and drive and anger cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Initiative and drive; the cost is friction with authority and a tendency to force things.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you shine and you go after what you want work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: You make it all about you
Let the reflex make the decision
